{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "# This is the main CI workflow that runs the test suite on all pushes to main and all pull requests.
# It runs the following jobs:
# - required: runs the test suite on ubuntu with the specified rust toolchains
# - direct-minimal: runs the test suite with the minimal versions of the dependencies that satisfy the
#   requirements of this crate
# - os-check: runs the test suite on mac and windows
# See check.yml for information about how the concurrency cancellation and workflow triggering works
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  pull_request:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
name: test
jobs:
  vars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup-components-history/
    outputs:
      nightly: nightly-2025-10-21
    steps:
      - run: echo "dummy job"
  required:
    needs: vars
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo generate-lockfile
        # enable this ci template to run regardless of whether the lockfile is checked in or not
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile
      # https://twitter.com/jonhoo/status/1571290371124260865
      - name: cargo test --locked
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
      # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --doc
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  direct-minimal:
    needs: vars
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }} / direct-minimal-versions
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
        run: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  os-check:
    # run cargo test on mac and windows
    needs: vars
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-15, windows-2025]
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:
      # if your project needs OpenSSL, uncomment this to fix Windows builds.
      # it's commented out by default as the install command takes 5-10m.
      # - run: echo "VCPKG_ROOT=$env:VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append
      #   if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      # - run: vcpkg install openssl:x64-windows-static-md
      #   if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo generate-lockfile
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --doc
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0", "rationale": "The workflow has no per-job timeout, so a hung or runaway job can consume the full default runner lifetime. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (evidence: experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) supports bounding jobs with an explicit timeout to prevent runaway consumption. Repository CI history shows successful runs completing in roughly 7-10 minutes, so a 30-minute timeout provides operational headroom without affecting valid runs. The change is applied only to the three cargo-test jobs (required, direct-minimal, os-check); the trivial vars echo job is left unchanged. Build and test coverage, matrix composition, fail-fast settings, concurrency cancellation, permissions, and all steps are preserved.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]}

# This is the main CI workflow that runs the test suite on all pushes to main and all pull requests.
# It runs the following jobs:
# - required: runs the test suite on ubuntu with the specified rust toolchains
# - direct-minimal: runs the test suite with the minimal versions of the dependencies that satisfy the

# - os-check: runs the test suite on mac and windows
# See check.yml for information about how the concurrency cancellation and workflow triggering works
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  pull_request:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
name: test
jobs:
  vars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup-components-history/
    outputs:
      nightly: nightly-2025-10-21
    steps:
      - run: echo "dummy job"
  required:
    needs: vars
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo generate-lockfile
        # enable this ci template to run regardless of whether the lockfile is checked in or not
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile
      # https://twitter.com/jonhoo/status/1571290371124260865
      - name: cargo test --locked
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
      # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --doc
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  direct-minimal:
    needs: vars
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }} / direct-minimal-versions
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
        run: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  os-check:

    needs: vars
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

        os: [macos-15, windows-2025]
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:

      #   if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:

      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:

      - name: cargo generate-lockfile
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''

      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:

      - name: cargo test --doc

          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
